results.criterion: The file is a single HTML file with its CSS and JavaScript inside it, and needs no build step or server.
results.note: One document with one style block and one script block (scripts: 1). Mechanical check lists only https://wa.me/ as an external resource, which is a link target.

results.criterion: The page names Sweet Crumbs Bakery and Pune, and has three clearly labelled sections: menu, cake orders, contact.
results.note: The title, h1 and footer name the bakery and Pune. Sections have ids menu, cake-orders and contact, with h2 headings Menu, Cake Orders and Contact. No broken in-page links.

results.criterion: The menu section lists items in groups; cake entries show a 'starting from' price and non-cake entries show a fixed price; any price not yet known is a visibly marked placeholder.
results.note: Three groups (Cakes plus two non-cake categories). Cake rows carry a 'starting from' label with a [PLACEHOLDER: starting price]. Non-cake rows carry [PLACEHOLDER: fixed price].

results.criterion: The cake order section has a form with fields for cake details (size, flavour, date, message), pickup or delivery choice, delivery area and delivery address.
results.note: Form#cake-form has inputs cake-size, cake-flavour, cake-date and cake-message, a fulfilment radio pair, a cake-area select and a cake-address textarea. Area and address are enabled only for Delivery.

results.criterion: Submitting the form opens a WhatsApp link (wa.me) whose message text is built from the form fields; the WhatsApp number is a single marked placeholder value in the script.
results.note: Single const WHATSAPP_NUMBER = "[PLACEHOLDER: WhatsApp number]". The submit handler builds 'https://wa.me/' + digits + '?text=' + encodeURIComponent(lines). Not run with a real number. With the placeholder it shows a preview instead of opening WhatsApp, which fits the placeholder rule.

results.criterion: The page states that delivery is available within a named list of Pune areas plus pickup, and the area list is in one editable block; if areas are not yet known the block holds marked placeholders.
results.note: The #area-list ul sits between EDITABLE BLOCK comments and holds three [PLACEHOLDER: Pune delivery area N] items. The page text says pickup or delivery within these areas. The form dropdown is built from this list.

results.criterion: The page states that orders are confirmed by the bakery after the WhatsApp message is sent.
results.note: The notice reads 'Orders are confirmed by the bakery... after you send the WhatsApp message.' The submit status text repeats it.

results.criterion: The contact section shows the bakery's address, phone, WhatsApp link and opening hours; any value not yet known is a visibly marked placeholder.
results.note: Four contact cards. Address, phone and hours are [PLACEHOLDER] markers. The WhatsApp link (#whatsapp-link) is set from the constant and is inert with a marker while the number is a placeholder.

results.criterion: The file contains no payment processing, no server calls and no storage of customer data.
results.note: The script contains no fetch, XHR, localStorage, cookie or payment code. The only outbound action is window.open to wa.me. js_errors is empty. The page states it takes no payment and stores no details.

results.criterion: Every placeholder in the file uses one consistent visible marker, and each one corresponds to an entry in open_inputs.
results.note: Every unknown fact uses the .ph style with the [PLACEHOLDER: ...] text. Each maps to an open_inputs entry: menu items and categories, prices, areas, address, phone, hours, WhatsApp number. The logo and brand colours input has no marker, but it is not a fact the page needs to state.

results.criterion: The file includes a responsive layout rule (viewport meta tag and a small-screen style) so the three sections stack and stay readable on a phone.
results.note: Viewport meta and @media (max-width: 640px) stacking rules are present, but the mechanical check shows phone 360px overflow_px: 61 (desktop 1280px: 0). The overflowing element is not identified, so the cause is unverified.
